Does Buffer Create Content For You?

Partly. Buffer is a scheduling, analytics and engagement tool with an AI writing assistant. It does not design graphics or edit videos; its AI Assistant can draft captions. You create all graphics and videos yourself using separate tools like Canva and CapCut.

No. Buffer is a generic social media scheduling tool used by restaurants, gyms, SaaS companies, and freelancers. It has no real estate templates, no local market content, and no industry-specific features.
